name: 35094 · Leeds, AL
findings: ZIP 35094 (Leeds) has 36 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (22%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 35094 (Leeds) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
38% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 35094 (Leeds) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 55% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 64% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
